description: Latest official value, change over a year and history of one indicator for one country, as charted on its Citoyen card: answers « what is the current rate », « how has it moved over the last months / quarters / years ». Values by period (newest first), unit, official producer, link to verify at the source, Citoyen page and CSV. Last 10 years by default.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code (FR, US, DE…), EU or WLD.

language.description: Language of names and period labels (default en).

years.description: Years of history before the latest point (default 10, max 80).

name: get_series
title: Get a Citoyen series
